title: You Massive Clod — Fearmoths, 1K for Linux
author: Fearmoths, the Debian project, busybox, PRISM
notes: Function 2008, 1K intro: ray marching of a distorted pow(cos(xyz), 2.0) surface with two directional lights, a hacked ELF header to fit in 1K. The intro runs as it was distributed: its dropper, a shell script, unpacks the compressed ELF to /tmp and starts it (busybox's sh, tail, zcat or lzcat), on Debian lenny's libc and dynamic loader (2009). Its libGL, libGLU, libSDL and libasound are made in JavaScript: the OpenGL calls and the GLSL go to PRISM's gl.js (vendor/prism), drawn by WebGL2; /usr/lib/libm.so is libc6-dev's link, the name it opens with dlopen.
